```{r packages}

library(ggplot2)

```



```{r loadData}

#Load all model outputs
data<-lapply(list.files("model-outputs/foraging/learning-evolution",full.names=T),read.csv)

#Rbind all CSVs together into one dataframe
data<-do.call("rbind",data)

```



```{r analysis}


#Create a dataframe for plotting average gamete size and fusion target over time
plotData<-data.frame("generation"=rep(sort(unique(data$generation)),length(unique(data$environmentPredict))))
plotData$predict<-rep(sort(unique(data$environmentPredict)),each=length(unique(data$generation)))
plotData$mean<-c(tapply(data$learningGene1,list(data$generation,data$environmentPredict),mean))

#Compute CIs on gamete sizes
plotData$lci<-c(tapply(data$learningGene1,list(data$generation,data$environmentPredict),function(x) mean(x)-sd(x)/sqrt(max(data$modelLoop))*qt(.975,max(data$modelLoop)-1)))
plotData$uci<-c(tapply(data$learningGene1,list(data$generation,data$environmentPredict),function(x) mean(x)+sd(x)/sqrt(max(data$modelLoop))*qt(.975,max(data$modelLoop)-1)))


```



```{r plot}


p0<-ggplot(data=plotData[plotData$predict==1,],
           aes(x=generation,y=mean,color=as.factor(predict)))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lci,ymax=uci))+
  labs(x="Generation",y="Proportion Agents\n w/ Learning Psychology",color="Environment\nPredictability")+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("firebrick3"))+
  geom_point(size=2)+
  geom_line(linewidth=1)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,1))+
  theme_grey(base_size=20)

p1<-ggplot(data=plotData,
           aes(x=generation,y=mean,color=as.factor(predict)))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lci,ymax=uci))+
  labs(x="Generation",y="Proportion Agents\n w/ Learning Psychology",color="Environment\nPredictability")+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("dodgerblue3","firebrick3"))+
  geom_point(size=2)+
  geom_line(linewidth=1)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,1))+
  theme_grey(base_size=20)+
  theme(legend.position="none")



```



```{r save}

ggsave("figures/MSAG Learning Evolution Figure (Pred 1).tiff",p0,width=12,height=6,units="in",dpi=300)
ggsave("figures/MSAG Learning Evolution Figure.tiff",p1,width=12,height=6,units="in",dpi=300)

```
